metadata.description: PulseSync is a SaaS startup founded in April 2024, specializing in real-time analytics and workflow optimization for remote and hybrid teams. The platform leverages AI to analyze collaboration patterns, provide actionable feedback, and automate routine tasks, helping companies maximize productivity and employee engagement. Currently serving SMBs, PulseSync aims to expand towards enterprise clients and enhance its feature set through integrations and partnerships.

product.name: PulseSync Platform
product.description: AI-powered productivity and analytics suite for hybrid teams

roadmap.milestone_title: Beta Feature Release: Smart Task Automation
roadmap.narrative_description: Launched beta of the Smart Task Automation module, enabling users to automate repetitive workflows and receive intelligent suggestions based on past activity. Early adopters provided feedback for refinement.
Successfully signed and onboarded our first enterprise client, a mid-sized tech firm, marking a significant step towards scaling beyond SMBs. Provided tailored onboarding and support.

roadmap.milestone_title: Integration with Slack and Microsoft Teams
roadmap.narrative_description: Released official integrations with Slack and Microsoft Teams, allowing users to synchronize workflows and analytics across popular collaboration platforms.
Closed a $3M Series A round led by a prominent VC, with participation from angel investors. Funds earmarked for product development, marketing, and team growth.
Hired four new engineers, focusing on AI and backend development, to accelerate feature rollout and improve platform scalability.
Released version 2.0 of the analytics dashboard, featuring enhanced visualizations, customizable reports, and deeper insights into team performance.

roadmap.milestone_title: Major B2B Win: Partnership with HR Tech Vendor
roadmap.narrative_description: Secured a strategic partnership with an HR tech vendor, enabling PulseSync’s analytics to be embedded within their employee management platform.
Completed rigorous security audits and achieved ISO 27001 certification, boosting customer confidence and meeting enterprise compliance requirements.
Surpassed 10,000 active user accounts across SMB and enterprise segments, reflecting strong adoption and positive retention metrics.
Formed a dedicated customer success team to support onboarding, drive engagement, and improve retention for growing client base.
Officially launched in the UK, adapting platform compliance and onboarding local sales reps. First UK clients onboarded successfully.
Rolled out AI-powered productivity insights, offering predictive analytics and actionable recommendations for managers. Received positive feedback from early enterprise users.
